name: Member Manager
description: Keep a roster of the people in your organization — name, email, optional phone and role. The roster is a members list of the space: members.table.jsonl, or one of several such as club.members.table.jsonl; an editor picks (or starts) the list each copy of the frame keeps. Editors add, edit and remove members; the owner names the organization, sets its roles and can make editing owner-only, for that copy. Members of the space read the roster with its contact details and tap an email or a phone number to write, call or text from their own device; anyone else the frame is shown to sees names and roles only. Community Library, Member Reachout and Garden Planner read the same list when they are pointed at it.
